# Resource Management



::: {.callout-note}
This chapter is in preparation. It will be built from **Lecture 11 -- Resource
Management** of MGMT-3105, following the same structure as
[Chapter 1](01-Sustainability.qmd) and
[Chapter 9](09-Cost-Estimation-and-Budgeting.qmd).
:::

## Learning objectives (planned)

By the end of this chapter you will be able to:

- Distinguish time-constrained from resource-constrained scheduling.
- Build a resource histogram and identify over-allocation.
- Apply resource levelling and resource smoothing, and explain their effect on the critical path and float.
- Explain the theory-of-constraints view of a project (critical chain, buffers).
- Plan for procurement of materials and outsourced work.
- Manage the sustainability dimension of resources: material efficiency, energy, and waste.

## Topic outline

1. Types of project resources: labour, equipment, material, facilities.
2. Resource loading and the resource histogram.
3. Over-allocation and the levelling problem.
4. Resource levelling vs. smoothing; splitting and multitasking costs.
5. Critical chain and buffer management.
6. Procurement and make-or-buy.
7. Sustainable resource use: circular-economy principles applied to the project.
8. Running case: levelling the RC-vehicle project team and tooling.
